description: Create folder, copy exact message, or save draft without sending. Defaults to SPECIAL-USE Drafts; preserves BCC. May duplicate; verify uncertain outcomes before retrying. revise_draft needs source_digest; omitted changes preserve, empty clears, attachments replaces all. Appends new revision in source folder by default; original retained. Strict MIME subset; no raw round-trip.

content_type.description: MIME type and optional parameters such as application/pdf

data_base64.description: Base64 bytes; maximum total decoded attachments 3 MiB

html.description: Optional authored HTML alternative; reviewed in full before sending

action.description: copy(reference,destination); draft(message; optional folder); folder(name); revise_draft(reference,source_digest,changes; optional folder). Reject other fields.

name: mail_create

description: Irreversible exact UID EXPUNGE, never global. Requires explicit per-action user confirmation and permanent-delete gate. Unavailable for Gmail/Workspace.
name: mail_delete_permanently

description: Add/remove flags, never Deleted; use unchanged_since with CONDSTORE, reread conflicts. Rename affects other clients. Move requires UID MOVE; Trash needs unique SPECIAL-USE. Refresh references afterward; never blindly retry uncertain outcomes.

action.description: flags(reference,operation,flags; optional unchanged_since); move(reference,destination); rename(old,new); trash(reference). Reject other fields.

name: mail_modify

description: Prepare immutable 15-minute message; does NOT send. Replies derive omitted To; reply_all also Cc. Lists replace; [] clears; null rejected. Quotes default on. Forward original_mode: quoted (default), eml (outer BCC removed, remaining bytes retained), none. attachment_indexes selects source files. Review complete text/HTML, recipients/BCC, warnings/hashes before mail_send_confirmed. draft requires exact ref/source_digest; freezes snapshot, retains original. Needs send scope/store.

action.description: draft(reference,source_digest); forward(reference,message; optional quote_original,original_mode,attachment_indexes); new(message); reply(reference,message; optional quote_original); reply_all(reference,message; optional quote_original). Reject other fields.

content_type.description: MIME type and optional parameters such as application/pdf

data_base64.description: Base64 bytes; maximum total decoded attachments 3 MiB

html.description: Optional authored HTML alternative; reviewed in full before sending

name: mail_prepare

description: Read-only; exact references and SPECIAL-USE names. Gmail labels overlap; All is not Archive. Bounded UID order; follow next_cursor on empty pages too. Triage: unread OR flagged, page counts. Conversation: same-folder ID links; search only folder/order/cursor/limit. PEEK reads; read_many batches 1-10 refs in input order with bounded JSON; inspect each status/next_index. Full detail opt-in. draft returns complete supported MIME with Bcc/HTML/files and source_digest; unsupported forms fail. Attachments: base64, max 2 MiB; never execute. send_status needs send scope/store, not sending enabled; expires_at is preparation deadline.

action.description: attachment(reference,index); capabilities(); conversation(reference; optional search,detail); draft(reference); folders(); read(reference; optional detail); read_many(references; optional detail,max_response_bytes); search(; optional search,detail); send_status(prepared_id); triage(; optional search,detail). Reject other fields.

max_response_bytes.description: read_many JSON payload budget: 4096-131072 bytes; default 65536

references.description: read_many: 1-10 exact references in input order

attention.description: Unread OR flagged; AND other filters

order.description: UID arrival order; newest is default

participant.description: Header substring: From/Reply-To/To/Cc; case-insensitive; no Bcc

name: mail_query

description: Send user-approved payload by exact prepared ID/digest. Durable one-time claim. accepted is SMTP acceptance, not delivery. Never retry/duplicate sending/unknown. Confirmation trusts client; no proof of human click. append_sent needs write scope; false for Gmail.
name: mail_send_confirmed
